entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s over a subquery wrapping a native-histogram-valued shape is unsupported
entries.rationale: The canonical range-function gate admits exactly the 26 names recognized by chplan.IsPromQLRangeWindowFunc. For histogram-bearing wideInner rows, lowerHistogramOrMixedCallSubqueryInput handles all fifteen SELECT/FOLD names, and histogramSubqueryFloatOnlyDropFunc handles the remaining eleven by returning an empty float result. requireMixedPlanPolicy and the earlier error returns cannot widen the admitted function set. The partition is exhaustive, so this trailing rejection is not wire-reachable.

guard: past returning if err := requirePositiveInnerRange(innerSub); err != nil
past returning if err := requireMixedPlanPolicy(wideInner, mixedSubqueryFamily); err != nil
past returning if node, matched, err := lowerHistogramOrMixedCallSubqueryInput(wideInner, shape, call.Func.Name, sub, innerSub, step, s, ctx); matched

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s does not accept a subquery argument
entries.rationale: lowerSubqueryOverCall is the only caller and dispatches here only after its own range-window vocabulary gate has admitted the call, so chplan.IsPromQLRangeWindowFunc has already answered true for the same canonicalised name by the time this check runs
